MWI.note: Submissions to MACRA are described without saying a draft or portal was online.
Submissions to a regulator on a law review; no public criticism of a named policy, cut or punishment stated.

facts.fact: MACRA took submissions on its review of the Communications Act from the Media Council of Malawi (20 October 2025) and MISA Malawi, and says a Digital Laws Task Force is reviewing them before sharing a first draft Communication Bill with key stakeholders.
